title: Supervision in the Hospitality Industry
duration: 45 hours (30 hours of lectures and 15 hours of discussions/practicals)

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the role of leadership in hotel management and its impact on business goals.
Apply management skills in hotel operations and departmental management.
Utilize supervision techniques to enhance operational efficiency in hotel departments.
Develop effective communication skills for conflict resolution and team management.
Manage recruitment, training, and performance evaluation of hotel staff.
Apply problem-solving techniques to address operational challenges in hotel management.
Implement time management strategies to optimize hotel operations.
Manage change effectively in hotel operations and staff development.
Create a positive work environment and motivate hotel staff.
